scene:
The picture has three areas side by side, read left to right, with no titles above them.

On the left third: a staircase of four steps rising from bottom-left to top-right, each step a navy-outlined block with one icon and its label: on the lowest step a speech bubble labelled EXPRESSION OF INTEREST; next an hourglass beside a meeting table labelled APPROVAL PENDING; next a blank signed paper with a small padlock and no words on the paper labelled SIGNED WITH CONDITIONS; on the top step a bank building with coins, coloured teal, labelled CASH RECEIVED. A small ochre pin marks the lowest step to show where the money is now; the pin has no text.

In the centre third: a runway chart with no axis, no numbers other than the labels, and no tick marks. At the top-left a large coin stack labelled €1.6M. Below it, three horizontal bars stacked one above the other, all starting at the same left edge under the coin stack, each ending in a small flag at its right end; each bar's label is written ONCE, just right of its flag: the top bar is the shortest, navy, ending at a flag labelled A: PROCEED, LATE NOV; the middle bar is longer, thick teal, ending at a flag labelled B: DEFER, 31 DEC; the bottom bar is the longest, a solid navy bar reaching further right than the teal bar, ending at a flag labelled C: BRIDGE, 31 MAR. Along the very bottom of the centre third runs a thin ochre dashed floor line labelled RESERVE €400K once at its left end.

On the right third, top to bottom: a blank desk calendar (no month name or numbers on it) with a gavel beside it, labelled DECIDE BY 15 AUG; below it a teal round stamp labelled B CHOSEN; at the bottom a closed gate with a large padlock, behind which stand a small office chair and a small laptop showing a web portal, labelled RESTART ONLY ON CASH RECEIVED.

TEXT: draw exactly these labels, each once and nothing else: EXPRESSION OF INTEREST, APPROVAL PENDING, SIGNED WITH CONDITIONS, CASH RECEIVED, €1.6M, RESERVE €400K, A: PROCEED, LATE NOV, B: DEFER, 31 DEC, C: BRIDGE, 31 MAR, DECIDE BY 15 AUG, B CHOSEN, RESTART ONLY ON CASH RECEIVED. The calendar, contract, laptop screen and chart axes carry no other writing or numbers. Never write the words LEFT, CENTRE, RIGHT, ZONE or any heading. Any other text is a defect.
alt: A four-step ladder shows how far expected money has got, from expression of interest through approval pending and a signed commitment to cash received; a cash chart falls from €1.6 million toward a €400,000 reserve, which proceeding as planned breaches in late November, deferring reaches on 31 December and a bridge loan pushes to 31 March; the decision is due by 15 August, deferral is chosen, and a locked gate holds deferred spending until cash is received.
caption: Price the alternatives by when each reaches the reserve, choose one before the deadline, and restart deferred spending only on cash received.
